rule: The knowledge bank may be deep; each public route is a selective, audience-specific projection. Update a route only through its canonical source files and rerun the full evaluation suite.

routes.changeRule: Keep only proofClaims selected by homepageProofs and preserve concise role-action-result framing.
exclusions: No private evidence, research queue, exhaustive project history, or unresolved metrics.
